display_title: [Pure Romance Anthology] The Secretary Can't Escape
description:
*"I want to be your secretary, sir."

"You want to choose? One, sell your organs. Two, go to people who might like the baby. Three, be my secretary." 

* What emerged from the man's arms was a "joint guarantee" document that would send Lee Hae-Na to hell. Alcoholism, domestic violence, neglect. Now it was a guarantee. Lee Hae-Na had only one choice: become the secretary of the man in front of her, Choi Tae-Geon. The man gave a sly smile at Lee Hae-Na's answer. She felt trapped, trapped.

 *"Have you ever slept with a man?"*

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.*
